issues.where: 3_tech, every face piece blue in all four views; techqa drift: eye 4, brow 2, beak 1
issues.what: The eyes, brows and beak sit on the face at rest but come off it in poses, because they ride a different transform from the face surface. The gap is too small to see at 4_posed scale, but the gauge is right, and the idle head turn is where it will show.
issues.fix: Stage 4: bind piece_eye, piece_brow and piece_beak with bone='head' (rigid, 100%). Weight every facial-disc vert above the throat band 100% head, with no neck blend.
issues.check: drift 0 on all three pieces; no blue in 3_tech; the pieces sit flush in idle_f012 and attack_f016.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000, face and throat
issues.what: The facial disc is a cream rectangle with straight vertical brown sides, cut off by a straight, full-width pale band across the throat. It reads as a box face with a collar, not a round disc with a rim. Round-1 item 7 was not done.
issues.fix: Stage 2: slide the disc-border verts inward on the two lower cheek loops (~8% of head width) so the disc narrows to a rounded bottom. Stage 3: paint the dark rim along those loops, and replace the straight band with a V bib that points down below the beak.
issues.check: az000: a rounded disc outline with a dark rim, and no band across the full head width; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 1_beauty az090, top of the head
issues.what: From the side, the two tufts overlap into one tall, narrow, vertical dark spike that reads as a horn.
issues.fix: Stage 2: tilt each tuft 15° back and 10° out, and shorten it 15%, so the two tips separate in profile.
issues.check: az090: two tuft tips angled back, neither vertical; the az000 tufts are unchanged.

issues.where: 2_closeups head colour, near brow
issues.what: The brow is still a dark plank standing off the face, and its outer tip pokes past the side of the head.
issues.fix: Stage 3: sink piece_brow 40% into the face and shorten the outer tip 20% so it ends inside the disc edge.
issues.check: head close-up: the brow tip is inside the face outline; az090: the brow projects less than the beak.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34 and az090, tail
issues.what: The tail is a thick, square-ended brick, heavier than the wing tips above it.
issues.fix: Stage 2: taper the tail 30% in thickness toward the tip and chamfer the end into a blunt point.
issues.check: back34: the tail ends in a taper, not a square cap; sliver ≤ 1%.

issues.where: 3_tech az090 and back34, back of the neck (purple); techqa flip 3
issues.what: A small posed fold-over sits where the head meets the back.
issues.fix: Stage 4: blend the head and neck weights 50/50 on the neck loop and 80/20 on the next loop down.
issues.check: no purple at the neck in 3_tech; flip 0.

issues.where: 2_closeups hind limb colour and wire, where the leg meets the belly
issues.what: A radial fan of about 8 triangles meets at one vertex and shows as a star of facets on the feathered leg.
issues.fix: Stage 2: dissolve alternate spokes into 4–5 bigger planes, or log a small inset at the pole.
issues.check: hind close-up: no star of facets, and no vertex there with more than 6 edges.

keep: front read: big orange eyes with black pupils and glints, V brows, beak, pale face on a brown head
back34: rounded head dome; the split-tip tufts from the front
feathered cream legs with tapered toes and dark talons, the talon strike, and clean wing roots (no purple at the shoulders)
owl.round1_fixed: Fixed: 1 (no wing-root flip: 3 in total, none at the shoulders), 3 (float 0 at rest), 4 (the head is a rounded dome in back34), 6 (toes tapered, with talons). Partly: 2 (the tips are no longer slivers, sliver 0.64%, but the tail is still a heavy plank); 5 (the tufts are split but the brows still jut). Not fixed: 7 (the throat is still a straight band and the beak shows no hook).

issues.where: 1_beauty hero, right side, and az090; 3_tech az090
issues.what: The walking legs are still long, straight, identical tapered spikes below a small knee. In az090 they stand as a row of vertical stakes that hold the body about a third of its height off the ground. The silhouette reads as a spider or harvestman, not a crab.
issues.fix: Stage 2: shorten each lower segment 20–25%. Add a second bend at ~70% of the leg so the tip angles back in under the body. Vary the splay: front pair 20° forward, rear pair 25° back, the middle two ≥ 10° apart. If IoU breaks, unlock stage 1 to drop the body until the underside clears the ground by ≤ 10% of height, and log it.
issues.check: az090: every leg shows an angle and none is a stake; hero: the four right legs are not parallel; az000: the body sits low between the knees.

issues.where: 2_closeups front-limb wire and barnacles wire, carapace top; the crown in every 4_posed frame; 1_beauty back34
issues.what: The carapace crown is still a radial fan of about 30 spokes on one pole, now circled by concentric rings. In colour it reads as a pot lid with ring bands, and the side wall is a pleated skirt of long thin triangles.
issues.fix: Stage 2: log two insets at the crown (a central plate and a ring) and dissolve the spokes so no top vertex has more than 8 edges. Flatten the ring into 5–6 big planes with a soft mid ridge. Merge the side-wall pleats into 6–8 wide planes.
issues.check: wire: no top vertex with more than 8 edges and no concentric bands; back34 and hero show a few big shell planes; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 1_beauty hero and back34; 2_closeups front-limb colour, carapace rim
issues.what: The toothed front edge is still missing: the rim outline is smooth in every view. The dark pleat triangles on the side wall are shading only and do not break the outline.
issues.fix: Stage 2: log a rim loop across the front third, then move alternate rim verts outward 4–6% of carapace width to cut 4–5 teeth per side, running from behind the eye stalks to the widest point.
issues.check: hero: 4–5 notches per side in the front rim outline; az000: teeth visible between the claws and the eye stalks; hit 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34; 2_closeups barnacles colour
issues.what: The barnacles are hexagonal prisms that read as nuts or bolts, and some are still spread over the top.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rebuild them as 3–4 truncated cones with a dark inset top, in mixed sizes (1–1.8×), clustered on the rear rim and sunk 30%.
issues.check: back34: one cluster on the rear edge that reads as barnacles; float 0.

keep: chunky claws with a real gap between the fingers, which snap in the attack
az000: the wide low shell with the claws in front reads as a crab; eye stalks with bulb eyes
clean tech (hit, float, zfight and flip all 0)
crab.round1_fixed: Fixed: 5 (claw gap, seated finger), 6 (thicker stalks with bulb eyes). Likely fixed: 4 (the legs change between move frames, so steps exist; planting cannot be proved from stills). Partly: 1 (a knee above the rim and black only on the tips, but the lower segments are still identical long spikes); 7 (the barnacles are larger and nearer the rear, but they are hex prisms). Not fixed: 2 (the pole fan is still on the crown), 3 (no toothed front edge).
